authorship: Original conditional role/composition review prose; not independently expert-validated or a combat simulation.

units.name: Gbeto
units.mechanic: Ranged delivery, melee damage, infantry armour classes: not an Archer merely because it throws a projectile. Mobility and attack timing matter; pierce armour alone is not protection from its primary attack.

units.name: Elite Gbeto
units.mechanic: Elite variant remains ranged melee infantry. Do not infer the Elite upgrade is complete from a research request or substitute basic Gbeto stats.

units.name: Hand Cannoneer
units.mechanic: Primary pierce damage with a separate infantry-class bonus. Needs Chemistry and protection; reload, accuracy, range and the opposing screen matter.

units.name: Skirmisher
units.mechanic: Anti-Archer bonuses depend on armour classes, not projectile appearance. Minimum range and low primary damage matter; this is not a universal answer to ranged melee infantry.

units.name: Elite Skirmisher
units.mechanic: Anti-Archer bonuses depend on armour classes. Elite status is not proof that a ranged melee target is an Archer-class target.

units.name: Scout Cavalry
units.mechanic: Reference base entry is not the unit's age/civilization-adjusted stats. A starting Scout is not represented by a production queue.

units.name: Camel Rider
units.mechanic: Mobile anti-cavalry support: do not treat a mixed Camel/Gbeto force as isolated ranged infantry or a simple Knight mirror.

units.name: Monk
units.mechanic: Conversion and healing support, not a primary damage attack. Needs protection and relevant research; conversion range, resistance and actual conversion outcomes are not reconstructed. Catalog reload is not conversion time.

units.name: Mounted Crossbowman
units.mechanic: Explicit mounted ranged unit, not a renamed Cavalry Archer. Mobility, attack delay and a supporting screen matter; a queue is not a successful kite or interception.

units.name: Heavy Mounted Crossbowman
units.mechanic: Explicit upgraded mounted-crossbow reference node. Do not repair unknown IDs or infer completed upgrades from requests.

units.name: Mangonel
units.mechanic: Ranged delivery with primary melee damage and an area attack. Minimum range, friendly-fire risk and protection matter; raw blast/attack entries are not a simulated hit or battle outcome.

units.name: Serjeant
units.mechanic: Can construct Donjons. The raw base entry does not include all age-dependent stat changes; a placement request does not establish a completed foothold.

units.name: Serjeant
units.mechanic: Explicit Donjon reference-node variant, not a guessed producer-ID shift. Age-dependent stats are not reconstructed.

units.name: Elite Serjeant
units.mechanic: Donjon construction and age/upgrade-dependent stats require more than a queue request to establish effective state.

units.name: Elite Serjeant
units.mechanic: Explicit Elite Donjon reference-node variant; not proof of actual producer location or surviving units.

units.name: Scorpion
units.mechanic: Piercing line attack; slow support needs a screen and positioning. High pierce armour does not make it safe from ranged melee damage.

units.name: Heavy Scorpion
units.mechanic: Piercing line attack; protect slow support from flanks. An upgrade request is not completion.

compositions.title: Mobile melee protection + ranged damage
compositions.conditions: If these options are available, funded and protected, compare a mobile melee screen/interception force with ranged damage behind it. Do not split off isolated cavalry into Spears or Camels.
compositions.limitations: Base speed differences do not prove a catch: upgrades, attack delay, pathing, terrain, numbers and supporting units remain unknown.
requires: safe food, wood and gold income

compositions.title: Protected gunpowder damage + mobile screen
compositions.conditions: Later, if Chemistry and the army can actually be completed, compare protected Hand Cannoneers with a mobile screen. Do not leave the gunners or slow siege exposed while chasing.
compositions.limitations: This is a conditional composition to inspect, not an equal-cost or combat-result claim. Supporting enemy cavalry or siege can change it.
requires: a frontline that protects the damage dealers

compositions.title: Protected ranged damage + a frontline
compositions.conditions: Against an infantry-focused threat, compare keeping a useful frontline with protected ranged damage instead of opening an unrelated unsupported line.
compositions.limitations: Armour, special mechanics, enemy ranged support and available numbers can change the answer. Do not generalize every infantry unit into the same counter.

cue: For a few reviews: name the recorded threat roles, what you actually saw, the job of your current response, and the support or funding needed before your next commitment. No saved habit is changed.
transition_questions: When did you actually see this threat? Opposing requests here are retrospective, not your vision.
Could your current response still do a useful job, or did its supporting mix need to change?
What safe resources, completed production, upgrades and protection would make the response sustainable?
